description: List what can be printed: SKUs (storybook books; custom-cut stickers from 500 pieces; greeting cards from 10; and, for platforms, sticker-a3 foam-board wall charts, one per order, and greeting-card-a5 folded cards from one copy), formats, supported trim sizes, page-count limits, prices (INR, shipping and GST included; paying online adds the Razorpay fee for the method, see online_payment), and shipping coverage (India only). Stickers and greeting cards are priced per piece in piece_prices. Every product takes an optional coupon on create_order, which takes a percentage off retail, never below making cost (the enterprise price). Each format lists the sizes an order chooses from in formats[].sizes (pass the id as size on create_order). Call this first to quote a price.
name: get_catalog
title: Print catalog and prices
